m1 - stack landed, nine of fifteen fields migrated. Working the remainder I want to argue that ONE OF THEM SHOULD NOT BE MIGRATED, because migrating it would be cargo-culting the ruling rather than applying it.

uniformCoverage = leaves.map(visitation).sum / leaves.size (signature.scala:264).

That is already a ratio of sums. The conditioning event is "this leaf exists in the source", and unlike specificity - where localizability is DEFINED on source mass and a count was therefore the wrong measure - a leaf is a discrete object and the count is the right one, exactly as for causalPreservation's edges.

What a MassRatio would add is support = A/T. But here A and T are both leaves.size: every leaf in the source is a leaf that could be visited. Support would be identically 1.0 on every input, which is not a measurement, it is a constant wearing a measurement's clothes. Publishing it would tell a reader that a coverage question had been asked and answered when nothing was asked. That is a smaller version of the defect we removed from importanceWeightedCoverage, which used to republish the uniform figure under a salience-weighted name.

So my recommendation is: uniformCoverage stays a Double, and the ADR gets a line saying WHY, so the next person auditing the migration list does not read an unmigrated field as an oversight. A field whose conditioning set is the whole population does not need a support carrier; it needs a note saying its support is trivially total.

THE ONE REAL DEFECT IN THAT LINE, which is not the carrier: `if leaves.isEmpty then 0.0`. A source with no leaves yields "this participant visited 0% of the source" when the truth is there was nothing to visit. Same conflation causalPreservation had - 0-of-0 rendered as a fact about the person. I checked reachability rather than assuming: infer does NOT guard against a view with no nodes the way it guards against an empty recall (hsmm.scala:467, 502, AlignError.EmptyRecall), so an all-External result over an empty view reaches this line. I have NOT confirmed anyone constructs such a view in practice, so I am calling it reachable-in-principle and low-consequence, not live.

I also confirmed the importance defect you queued me is genuinely closed: importanceWeightedCoverage is Missing(AllMissing) when wsum <= 0 rather than republishing uniform, so the two fields are no longer identical by construction.

REMAINING GENUINELY UNMIGRATED: the six external mass terms and distortedMass, all of which go through extMean's count denominator. I have NOT touched them - I reported the extMean finding to codex-storymodel-new-engineer since externalMass is their bead, and distortedMass shares the same helper. Say the word if you would rather I took distortedMass directly; I held off to avoid two of us in one expression.
